blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Erwin Tulfo has filed a bill that seeks to provide safeguards for employees displaced by artificial intelligence (AI) amid reports of massive layoffs as companies adopt AI in their operations. While acknowledging that technological progress is inevitable, Tulfo, who chairs the Senate Committee on Social Justice, Welfare, and Rural Development, stressed that Filipino workers should not be left behind or made to bear its costs alone. “As companies adopt AI, employees whose jobs become redundant risk losing not only their employment but also their means of supporting their families,” Tulfo said in a statement on Sunday.
